info.name: Slide & Solve - API Collection
info.description:
API collection for Slide & Solve Google Ads Configuration Engine and Admin Authentication.

### Environments
- **Production:** `https://slide-solve.kalpvarti.com`
- **Localhost:** `http://localhost:3000`

### Authentication
Admin endpoints use session-based cookies (`slide_solve_sid`). State-changing endpoints (PUT/POST) require the `x-csrf-token` header, which is automatically saved to the collection variable `csrfToken` upon running the Login endpoint.

variable.description: API Base URL (e.g., https://slide-solve.kalpvarti.com or http://localhost:3000)
Auto-populated by the Login request test script

item.name: 1. Admin Authentication
item.description: Admin login, profile session check, and logout endpoints.

exec: // Automatically extract and store the CSRF token from the response

request.description: Authenticates the admin user using username/email and password. Returns user info, establishes a session cookie (`slide_solve_sid`), and provides a CSRF token.
Checks current admin session validity, returning profile information and the active CSRF token.
Destroys the server session and clears the `slide_solve_sid` authentication cookie.

item.name: 2. Admin Google Ads Management
item.description: Protected endpoints to read and update Google Ads remote settings.

request.description: Retrieves the current Google Ads configuration from PostgreSQL for the Admin Panel (Admin Auth Required).

header.description: Security CSRF token auto-populated by the Admin Login request
